# The model-mode view drags of pump_navigation.cpp: shift + right drag and
# the middle drag (plain, shift, ctrl) move the view offset; a plain right
# drag orbits, ctrl + right drag changes the distance. The PMM saves them.
load model chain8.pmx
view drag right shift 40 -20
save pmm shift-right.pmm
view drag middle none 10 30
save pmm middle.pmm
view drag middle shift -4 2
view drag middle ctrl 0 100
save pmm middle-modifiers.pmm
view drag right none 15 5
view drag right ctrl 0 10
save pmm orbit.pmm
